title: ITERALIGN: Iterative Constitutional Alignment of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'Constitutional Alignment,' a methodology specifically designed to align Large Language Models with human ethical standards and societal norms. The framework involves automatically discovering and enforcing ethical principles (constitutions) to ensure model safety, and the evaluation uses the HHH (Helpfulness, Honesty, Harmlessness) criteria, which are rooted in ethical alignment.
